import math
pts_l = [(int(r),int(c)) for r,c in pts]
def solve(A, marker, fill=3):
    H,W = A.shape
    P = [(int(r),int(c)) for r,c in np.argwhere(A==marker)]
    # nearest-neighbor cycle
    unvis = set(P)
    cur = min(P)
    order=[cur]; unvis.remove(cur)
    while unvis:
        nxt = min(unvis, key=lambda q:(q[0]-cur[0])**2+(q[1]-cur[1])**2)
        order.append(nxt); unvis.remove(nxt); cur=nxt
    # rasterize walls
    wall = np.zeros_like(A, bool)
    def line(a,b):
        r0,c0=a; r1,c1=b
        dr,dc = r1-r0, c1-c0
        n = max(abs(dr),abs(dc))
        if n==0: return
        # require 8-directional
        if not (dr==0 or dc==0 or abs(dr)==abs(dc)): return None
        for i in range(n+1):
            wall[r0+round(dr*i/n), c0+round(dc*i/n)] = True
    seg_ok = True
    for i in range(len(order)):
        a,b = order[i], order[(i+1)%len(order)]
        dr,dc = b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]
        if not (dr==0 or dc==0 or abs(dr)==abs(dc)): seg_ok=False
        line(a,b)
    vis = np.zeros_like(A,bool); q=deque()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r in (0,H-1) or c in (0,W-1)) and not wall[r,c]:
                vis[r,c]=True; q.append((r,c))
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not vis[nr,nc] and not wall[nr,nc]:
                vis[nr,nc]=True; q.append((nr,nc))
    out = A.copy()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if A[r,c]==marker: continue
            if wall[r,c] or not vis[r,c]:
                out[r,c]=fill
    return out, seg_ok, order
pred, ok, order = solve(A, 4)
print("all segs 8-dir:", ok, "closed nn cycle len:", len(order))
print("match demo:", (pred==B).all(), "mismatch count:", (pred!=B).sum())
if (pred!=B).any():
    for r in range(A.shape[0]):
        line_s = ''
        for c in range(A.shape[1]):
            if pred[r,c]!=B[r,c]: line_s+='X'
            elif B[r,c]==3: line_s+='#'
            elif A[r,c]==4: line_s+='4'
            else: line_s+='.'
        print(line_s)
